WITH window_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS duplicate_rows
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-24'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25'
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS duplicate_rows
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-24'
)
SELECT
  w.duplicate_rows AS value,
  ROUND(b.duplicate_rows::DOUBLE / 7, 4) AS baseline,
  w.total_rows AS window_total_rows,
  w.distinct_orders AS window_distinct_orders,
  b.total_rows AS baseline_total_rows,
  b.distinct_orders AS baseline_distinct_orders,
  ROUND(w.total_rows::DOUBLE / NULLIF(w.distinct_orders, 0), 4) AS window_rows_per_distinct_order,
  ROUND(b.total_rows::DOUBLE / NULLIF(b.distinct_orders, 0), 4) AS baseline_rows_per_distinct_order
FROM window_stats w, baseline_stats b;
